question.EN: In the complex given in the image, what is the IUPAC name and the hybridization of the central metal atom? [Co(NH3)6]3+
question.HI: In the complex given in the image, what is the IUPAC name and the hybridization of the central metal atom? [Co(NH3)6]3+

explanation.EN: Cobalt is in +3 oxidation state (3d6 configuration). NH3 is a strong field ligand according to the spectrochemical series, causing pairing of d-electrons. This leaves two internal 3d orbitals vacant, leading to d2sp3 (inner orbital octahedral) hybridization. The name is Hexaamminecobalt(III) ion.
